text:
Alex Chen: Quick thought — should we change default precedence to prefer signed auth headers over User-Agent for routing? Spoofing risk with X-Customer-Env still high.
Priya Rao: +1 on preferring signed headers. We can't rely on UA alone. Need a clear fallback chain though.
Kevin Morales: What about mixed cases where UA indicates mobile but signed header absent? Route to 'best-effort' pool or generic default? Also need to be careful with quota attribution.
Marta Silva: We should add a validation step at the gateway: verify signature header (X-RW-Signature) and timestamp, then set a `routing.priority` tag. If invalid -> strip and fallback to next rule.
Dana Patel: UX ask: console needs a route preview that shows the final matched route after header validation so customers can test permutations.
Alex Chen: proposal sketch for rule ordering and behaviour:
```
route_rules:
  - match: { header: X-RW-Signature, verify: true, route: dedicated-verified }
  - match: { header: X-Customer-Env, route: tenant-shard }
  - match: { user_agent: /Redwood-Mobile/, route: mobile-pool }
  - fallback: shared-hosted
```
If signature verification fails, we rewrite the header (strip X-Customer-Env/X-RW-Signature) and continue. Need to avoid leaking the invalid header to upstream.
Priya Rao: Also add telemetry tag `routing.source` = ["signed_header","custom_header","user_agent","fallback"]. Surface that in per-route dashboards and traces.
Kevin Morales: Quotas: signed routes should be charged against the dedicated quota; fallbacks against shared quota. To avoid double-charging, do evaluation+tagging before quota check and make the quota call once.
Marta Silva: Security detail: signing scheme proposal — HMAC-SHA256 over `ts|env|customer_id` with header `X-RW-Signature: v1=hex,h=ts`. Gateway caches tenant public keys / shared secrets with TTL and rejects if replay or clock skew beyond 60s.
Dana Patel: Console UX: add a "Test headers" box in the route editor that shows the evaluated route and the decision trace. Example curl tested inline:
```
curl -H "X-Customer-Env: acme-prod" -H "X-RW-Signature: v1=..." https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Alex Chen: telemetry also needs `routing.decision_trace` (short array of rule hits + reasons) so SREs can debug noisy misroutes without full logs.
Priya Rao: FYI deploy-bot will push a canary for header-validation on staging at 09:30 UTC. We'll watch routing.source distributions and error rates.
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy of `gateway/header-validation` -> staging (build 20260315-42). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/42 :rocket:
Kevin Morales: I'll watch quota meter and billing tags during the canary. If any unexpected charge spikes ping me.
Marta Silva: I'll add unit+integration tests for signature edge-cases (clock skew, missing key, replay, malformed sig). Also adding an e2e with a spoof attempt to ensure headers are stripped.
Dana Patel: @Alex can you add a short spec for the console UI so design can mock the preview and the decision trace visualization? Need sample text for the tooltip explaining "why you were routed here".
Alex Chen: will do, attaching quick mock in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcdef — I'll include the sample decision trace formats.
Priya Rao: Proposed rollout plan: staging canary -> 24h metrics review (routing.source, signature_fail_rate, misroute_count) -> opt-in prod with tenant flag -> 7d monitoring -> full rollout.
Alex Chen: SGTM :thumbsup:
